command: Run retained-RocketTile official/raw mvin/mvout equivalence for fixed edge matrix: 1x1, 1x16, 16x1, 15x16, 16x15, unaligned DRAM offsets, accumulator INT32 input, and INT8/INT32 output paths. Then continue conv, bias/requant, queue backpressure, completion/event, and illegal descriptor. Use taskset -c 8-25, MemAvailable >10 GiB, at most -j4, and a memory cgroup.
success_condition: All required Gemmini L2 operations match their official C/RTL paths in retained RocketTile context with identical command/write/event traces and bit-exact outputs; upstream remains clean.
failure_policy: Stop at the first command/write/event divergence. Do not connect the clean-room adapter to the official macro, hand-write TileLink/PTW behavior, skip WS/conv/event coverage, relax numerical checks, or mark L2 PASS.
